locations.title: Burst Skill
locations.description:
Dropped by  the [Stalker](#loc=464837).

A successful Perfect Dodge, Blink, or Repulse charges Burst Energy. You can use charged Burst Energy for Burst Skills.

Burst Skills can be acquired from kiosks.

locations.title: Password-Protected Door Panel
locations.description:
On the raised section of the room.

The password (**N72R5**) can be found by using the [Lever](#loc=464846) to wash blood off the train.

locations.title: Lever
locations.description: On the platform next to the ladder. Use it to rotate and clean the train, revealing the password for the [Password-Protected Door Panel](#loc=464844)
